rules.run_provenance: repro_sweep; only these runs can be best_in_sweep.
rules.fidelity_source: Saved nine-field pickle, field 7. Analytic saved fidelities independently checked using the saved encoder/decoder and active loss sectors; no decoder solve. All publication analytic files are saved at their caption eta.
rules.rounds: Completed runs save requested rounds, not accepted iterations (completed_rounds=null). Timed-out checkpoints save accepted history length; later unsaved iterations are unknown.
rules.symmetry: A structural-family match does not upgrade a run's symmetry confidence or endpoint convergence status.
rules.commutator_loss: Present only on the best_in_sweep run at each parameter point. Normalized group-commutator loss for its recorded symmetry fit, verified using the active routine at the authoritative saved alignment. Paired with invariant_overlap; distinct from numerical-to-analytic pair overlaps and display rotations.
rules.paths: All active file and script paths are relative to the release root. Scientific modules and group data are bundled under code/.
rules.symmetry_fit: Stored on each best_in_sweep run. Replay this verified group fit using check_symmetry.py and the bundled active routines. alignment_euler uses rotate_projector_euler (the plotting convention), after occupation-basis conjugation, in the canonical group frame; it is distinct from pair-comparison and final viewing angles. These cached fits reproduce commutator_loss and invariant_overlap, not a certified global optimum.
rules.analytic_canonical_symmetry: Where recorded, canonical_symmetry verifies the irrep allocation in the saved occupation-basis frame, with identity rotation and no conjugation. It is separate from comparison and plotting rotations.
